sentences.C. Jeg står opp klokka seks: C. I get up at six o'clock
sentences.Vekkerklokka på mobilen ringer klokka se: The alarm on my mobile goes off at six o'clock in the morning.
sentences.Da våkner jeg, men jeg er trøtt og kaffe: Then I wake up, but I'm tired and dying for coffee.
I get up and make coffee.
sentences.Så går jeg på badet. Jeg tar en dusj og: Then I go to the bathroom. I have a shower and put on my make-up.
sentences.Klokka halv sju spiser jeg frokost, men: At half past six I have breakfast, but I can't manage to eat very much.
sentences.Jeg drikker to eller tre kopper kaffe. D: I drink two or three cups of coffee. That helps a bit.
The bus leaves at seven o'clock.
I have a job at a hotel.
sentences.Der vasker jeg rommene og rer opp sengen: There I clean the rooms and make the beds.
sentences.Jeg jobber cirka fem timer hver formidda: I work about five hours every morning.
sentences.Jeg begynner klokka halv åtte og er ferd: I start at half past seven and finish at about half past twelve.
sentences.Til lunsj pleier jeg å spise varm mat i: For lunch I usually eat a hot meal in the canteen at work.
I don't make a packed lunch.
After lunch I hurry to the bus.
sentences.Jeg går på norskkurs fra kvart over to t: I go to the Norwegian course from quarter past two to quarter to five.
sentences.På kurset prøver vi å snakke norsk med h: On the course we try to speak Norwegian to each other.
After the Norwegian course I go home.
sentences.Jeg er gift med Ole, men han er ikke hje: I'm married to Ole, but he isn't at home now.
He works in the North Sea.
sentences.Noen dager lager jeg middag hjemme, men: Some days I make dinner at home, but often I just have a cup of tea and eat a few biscuits or a bit of chocolate.
sentences.Etterpå sover jeg litt på sofaen. Så gjø: Afterwards I sleep a little on the sofa. Then I do my Norwegian homework.
sentences.Om kvelden liker jeg å se på tv og slapp: In the evening I like to watch TV and relax.

sentences.Da tar jeg noen skiver brød og kanskje e: Then I have a few slices of bread and maybe a glass or two of wine.
sentences.Jeg pleier å legge meg før elleve og sov: I usually go to bed before eleven and sleep until six o'clock.
